title: Knights of the Dinner Table
description: Find the optimal circular seating arrangement to maximize happiness.
writeup:
## Approach

Another small-scale permutation problem — very similar to Day 9's TSP. With 8 guests and a circular table, fixing one person's position eliminates rotational duplicates, leaving 7! = 5,040 arrangements to evaluate.

## Part 1

Parse the happiness rules into a lookup table, then brute-force all circular permutations. For each arrangement, sum the bidirectional happiness of every adjacent pair (including the wrap-around). Return the maximum.

## Part 2

Add yourself to the table with 0 happiness toward and from everyone. This increases the search to 8! = 40,320 arrangements — still trivially fast. The optimal score drops because "Me" contributes nothing but breaks up a previously beneficial pairing.
